WESTBROOK COUNTY MEDICAL EXAMINER
AUTOPSY REPORT (SUMMARY)
Decedent: Whitfield, Marcus
DOB: 02/18/1968    DOD: 09/22/2024 03:48
ME Case No.: ME-2024-09-1144
Examiner: Dr. P. Achterberg, MD, Forensic Pathologist
Autopsy Date: 09/23/2024

GROSS FINDINGS:
- Body of well-developed 56 y.o. male, 184 cm, 91 kg.
- Meninges: diffuse purulent exudate over cerebral convexities, most prominent over frontal and parietal regions.
- Brain: marked cerebral edema, weight 1,612 g (expected ~1,450), with tonsillar herniation.
- Heart, lungs, liver, kidneys: congestion consistent with septic shock.

MICROSCOPIC:
- Meninges: dense neutrophilic infiltrate with Gram-negative diplococci on Gram stain. Findings diagnostic of acute bacterial meningitis.
- Brain parenchyma: vasogenic edema, scattered cortical neuronal necrosis.

MICROBIOLOGY:
- Antemortem CSF (09/20/2024): culture positive for Neisseria meningitidis, serogroup B.
- Antemortem blood cultures: positive for N. meningitidis (drawn 04:48 09/20/2024; resulted 09/21/2024 08:30).
- Postmortem cardiac blood: positive for N. meningitidis.

CAUSE OF DEATH:
Septic shock due to acute bacterial meningitis (Neisseria meningitidis serogroup B).

MANNER OF DEATH: Natural.

NOTE: Pathology is consistent with a treatable bacterial infection. Outcome was not predetermined by host factors; decedent had no immunocompromise and no comorbidities increasing baseline mortality risk.

/s/ Dr. P. Achterberg, MD
